text: Good afternoon, may mga naipon kami sa bahay pagkatapos ng ilang linggo, including plastic water bottles, aluminum soft drink cans, at lumang diyaryo na nakalagay sa isang malaking sako. Gusto sana naming ibenta lahat.

We recently cleaned our small grocery store and found several flattened cardboard delivery boxes, old newspapers, used paper bags, and plastic packaging from the products we sold. Can we bring all these materials to your junkshop for weighing and pricing?

May mga bote ng suka at garapong salamin kami galing sa kusina, kasama ang mga plastik na lalagyan ng pagkain at ilang lata ng aluminum soft drinks. Hindi pa namin naihihiwalay lahat dahil gusto muna naming malaman kung alin ang puwedeng ibenta sa inyo.

I found several old steel pipes, copper wires, and rusty iron brackets inside our storage room while repairing the house. There are also broken phone chargers, damaged computer cables, and plastic covers from some electronic devices. Do you accept these different materials?

After our family gathering, marami kaming natirang recyclable materials, such as aluminum food trays, empty glass juice bottles, cardboard boxes from food deliveries, and old paper plates' packaging. May ilang lumang magazine at papel din na gusto naming isama sa pagbebenta.

May nililinis kaming lumang computer shop at marami kaming nakitang sirang keyboard, computer mouse, power adapters, at mga electronic cable. Bukod doon, may plastic chairs, plastic storage containers, at bakal na piyesa mula sa mga lumang computer tables. Puwede ba itong dalhin nang sabay-sabay?

Our office is moving to another building, so we need to dispose of some recyclable materials we have accumulated over the years. We have stacks of printed paper, old notebooks, cardboard folders and boxes, glass containers from the pantry, and plastic water bottles from our employees.

May mga lumang aluminum window frames at crushed beverage cans kami mula sa renovation, pati na rin ang bakal na rods, steel brackets, at ilang tansong wire na natira pagkatapos ng pagkukumpuni. Nasa tabi rin ang mga kahon ng karton na pinaglagyan ng bagong construction materials.

I was sorting through our family's old belongings and found shampoo bottles, plastic detergent containers, old magazines, used printer paper, broken earphones, and a damaged router. There are also several empty glass perfume bottles and sauce jars that we kept in a separate box.

May halo-halong recyclables kami sa bodega na gusto naming ibenta this week. Kasama rito ang plastic pails at water bottles, lumang diyaryo at notebooks, mga kahon ng karton, aluminum cans, bakal na pipes, copper wires, glass jars, at sirang cellphone chargers. Hindi pa namin alam kung magkano ang kabuuang presyo kaya gusto naming ipa-check muna lahat.

Hello, we finally cleaned out our garage over the weekend and collected quite a lot of things that we think might be recyclable. There are some plastic buckets and containers, a pile of newspapers and paper bags, several cardboard shipping boxes, empty glass bottles, aluminum cans, and a few old metal parts from a broken shelf.

Boss, galing po ito sa maliit naming sari-sari store na pinaayos last week. May mga plastic bottles at wrappers, karton ng mga delivery, lumang papel at resibo, aluminum cans, at bakal na shelves na hindi na ginagamit. May nakita rin kaming sirang extension cord at lumang charger sa stockroom. Ano po kaya ang puwede ninyong bilhin sa mga ito?

During our school laboratory cleanup, we separated old worksheets, used notebooks, cardboard boxes, and paper packaging from the cabinets. We also found rusty steel brackets, some copper wires, damaged computer keyboards, and several old power adapters that have not worked for a long time.

May mga bote ng soft drinks na salamin, aluminum cans, plastic cups, at mga lalagyan ng mineral water na naiwan pagkatapos ng community event. Sa likod ng covered area, may nakita rin kaming bakal na frame at ilang metal rods na ginamit sa decoration. Gusto sana naming malaman kung tumatanggap kayo ng ganitong karaming halo-halong gamit.

We are clearing the stockroom of our online selling business because we need space for new inventory. We have cardboard shipping cartons, plastic bubble packaging and wrappers, old paper labels and invoices, aluminum cans from the pantry, and a box of damaged charging cables and adapters. Some items are still mixed together because we have not finished sorting.

Kuya, may sako-sako po kaming lumang gamit na naipon sa bahay ng lola ko. May mga bote na plastik, garapong salamin, dyaryo, papel, kahon ng karton, lata ng soft drinks, at ilang piraso ng bakal. May lumang charger at sirang earphones din po akong nakita sa drawer. Puwede po bang lahat na lang ang dalhin namin sa junkshop ninyo?

Our maintenance team replaced some damaged fixtures in the workshop and put the discarded materials in one corner. The pile contains steel pipes, iron rods, copper wiring, old aluminum frames, empty glass jars, and cardboard boxes that were used to transport replacement parts. We want to separate everything according to material before selling it.

Kahapon naglinis kami ng bahay dahil matagal nang hindi nagagamit ang storage area sa likod. Nakakita kami ng plastic basins, lumang shampoo bottles, mga kahon ng sapatos, lumang notebooks, at mga diyaryo. May mga aluminum trays at lata rin galing sa handaan, kasama ang mga bote ng salamin at sirang computer mouse. Sa garahe naman ay may bakal na kadena at tansong wire mula sa dati naming pagkukumpuni.

I'm not completely sure which of these items your junkshop accepts, but I would like to ask about a collection from our old warehouse. We have plastic containers, cardboard cartons, paper documents, aluminum scraps, steel pieces, glass bottles, and several damaged electronic accessories such as chargers and cables. Some materials are dirty or slightly damaged, so please identify the different categories before we arrange a pickup.

Good morning po, may mga recyclable materials kami mula sa bahay at maliit naming tindahan na gusto naming ibenta. May plastic pails, bottles, at food containers; lumang papel, notebooks, at diyaryo; mga kahon ng karton; aluminum cans at trays; bakal na pipes at copper wire; mga garapong salamin; at sirang cellphone chargers, computer cables, at keyboard. Nasa magkakahiwalay na sako at kahon ang iba pero may ilang halo-halo pa. Sana matulungan ninyo kaming matukoy ang bawat materyal at malaman kung alin ang may buying price.
We are cleaning the stockroom and have flattened cardboard cartons, old newspapers, plastic wrap, and aluminum drink cans. Can we bring all four types in one visit?
May mga garapong salamin, plastik na bote, at lumang diyaryo po kami. Mayroon ding sirang charger at ilang pirasong bakal mula sa lumang cabinet. Alin dito ang puwedeng ibenta?
Our sari-sari store has empty plastic detergent bottles, cardboard product boxes, aluminum cans, and old paper price lists. We sorted them into separate bags before contacting you.
After renovating the kitchen, we found steel pipes and iron brackets, glass jars from the pantry, and a box of broken electronic adapters. We would like to sell the recyclable items together.
May mga lumang notebook at diyaryo, karton ng delivery, bote ng shampoo, at lata ng soft drinks po kami. Nahiwalay na ang bawat klase para mas madaling timbangin.
The school cleanup produced paper worksheets, cardboard boxes, plastic water bottles, and a broken computer keyboard. Do you accept all these materials for recycling?
Boss, may aluminum cans at foil trays po kami, kasama ang mga glass bottles at garapon. May lumang steel shelf din na puwede nang gawing scrap metal.
We emptied a small office and collected old printed documents, cardboard archive boxes, broken routers, and plastic cable organizers. The materials are separated and ready for pickup.
May mga sirang earphones at charger, lumang bakal na tubo, mga bote ng suka na salamin, at plastic containers po kaming gustong ipa-recycle.
A neighborhood store has stacks of cardboard cartons, aluminum soda cans, glass beverage bottles, and plastic food tubs. We want to know which of these your shop can purchase.
We have old magazines and paper bags, plus empty plastic gallons and aluminum cooking trays from the canteen. Everything is dry and has been sorted by material.
May mga kahon ng karton, lumang papel, at plastik na supot sa tindahan. Nakakita rin kami ng sirang keyboard at charger habang naglilinis ng opisina.
Our garage cleanup left copper wire, steel brackets, glass jars, plastic pails, and a stack of cardboard delivery boxes. Can these different recyclables be weighed separately?
May aluminum na lata, lumang diyaryo, karton ng appliance, at mga bote ng shampoo po kami. May sirang mouse at power adapter din mula sa computer table.
We are clearing a small café: glass sauce bottles, aluminum cans, cardboard ingredient boxes, and plastic containers are ready for recycling. We also have old steel shelving parts.
Sa school storage room, may mga lumang activity sheets, karton, plastik na bote, at sirang router. May mga bakal na bracket din mula sa lumang shelves.
Our family gathered empty glass jars, aluminum food cans, old newspapers, and plastic laundry bottles during a weekend cleanup. Can we sell these in one trip?
May mga kahon ng karton at lumang papel po mula sa tindahan, kasama ang aluminum cans, glass bottles, at mga sirang charger na hindi na ginagamit.
The workshop has scrap iron rods and copper wire, a broken computer mouse, paper instruction manuals, and cardboard packaging. We kept the materials in separate containers.
May plastic containers, garapong salamin, lumang diyaryo, at lata ng aluminum po kaming naipon. May mga karton din mula sa bagong delivery ng paninda.
Our apartment building collected plastic bottles, cardboard cartons, glass jars, and a damaged router during a cleanup day. We want to know which items can be recycled.
Boss, may lumang bakal na hinges, aluminum cans, paper folders, at karton po kami. May mga sirang earphones din at plastic packaging mula sa deliveries.
The grocery backroom has cardboard boxes, plastic wrapping, aluminum drink cans, and old paper receipts. A broken barcode scanner and damaged power adapter are also in the electronic-waste bin.
May mga bote ng salamin, plastik na galon, at lumang papel po sa bahay. Kasama rin ang sirang bakal na rack at ilang lata ng soft drinks.
We are sorting materials from a small repair shop: steel brackets, copper wires, cardboard packaging, old paper manuals, and damaged circuit boards. There are also empty plastic containers.
May mga aluminum tray, glass jars, karton, at plastic bottles po mula sa canteen. Nakakita rin kami ng lumang keyboard at sirang charger sa office drawer.
A family moved house and set aside old magazines, cardboard boxes, plastic storage bins, glass sauce jars, and a broken modem. They would like to sell what the junkshop accepts.
May lumang diyaryo, notebook, plastic pails, aluminum cans, at bakal na tubo po kami. Galing ito sa paglilinis ng bahay at garahe.
Our office renovation produced steel rails, copper wiring, cardboard cartons, paper files, and several broken computer accessories. We also found glass jars in the pantry.
May mga karton ng appliance, bote ng shampoo, garapon ng salamin, at aluminum cans po kaming ibebenta. May lumang bakal na brackets din mula sa repair.
We cleaned a classroom and found stacks of worksheets, cardboard art boxes, plastic drink bottles, and an old damaged projector remote. Can these all be assessed for recycling?
May sirang charger at mouse, glass bottles, aluminum trays, at lumang diyaryo po kami. May mga plastic containers din mula sa kitchen storage.
A small restaurant has cardboard food-supply boxes, aluminum beverage cans, glass condiment bottles, and plastic buckets. It also has a damaged electronic weighing scale.
May mga bakal na tubo, lumang paper forms, karton, at plastic packaging po mula sa warehouse. Nasa hiwalay na kahon ang mga sirang router at charger.
We collected glass bottles, old newspapers, aluminum cans, and steel scraps from the community hall. A box of damaged phone chargers and a few plastic containers were found too.
May mga karton, diyaryo, bote ng tubig na plastic, at garapong salamin po kami. Kasama ang lumang steel shelf at sirang keyboard na nasa storage.
The school canteen is clearing its storeroom and has aluminum trays, cardboard supply boxes, paper menus, glass drink bottles, and empty plastic food containers.
May lumang copper wire, bakal na bracket, charger, at circuit board po mula sa repair shop. May mga kahon ng karton at lumang paper manuals din kaming naipon.
Our household has old magazines and newspapers, plastic laundry bottles, aluminum pans, glass jars, and several cardboard delivery boxes ready to be sorted.
May mga lata ng soft drinks, bote ng suka, lumang diyaryo, at plastic pails po. Nakakita rin kami ng sirang router at ilang steel hinges habang naglilinis.
The repair shop has old steel pipes, cardboard packaging, used paper manuals, empty plastic lubricant containers, and a damaged handheld electronic meter.
May aluminum foil trays, cardboard boxes, plastic containers, at glass jars po mula sa catering supplies. May mga lumang pako at bakal na hinges din sa bodega.
We are clearing a community office and found old paper forms, plastic folders, cardboard storage boxes, aluminum cans, and a broken desktop keyboard.
May mga garapong salamin, lumang diyaryo, karton ng delivery, at plastic bottles po kami. May sirang earphones at charger rin mula sa lumang cellphone.
A warehouse cleanup uncovered metal brackets, copper wire, glass bottles, cardboard cartons, plastic wrapping, and a broken Wi-Fi router. We sorted everything before asking for prices.
May aluminum cans, lumang notebook, plastic pails, at karton po kami. Kasama rin ang glass jars at sirang power adapter mula sa office.
Our school has old printed worksheets, cardboard project boxes, empty plastic water bottles, and aluminum cans. The IT room also has a damaged mouse and several unusable chargers.
May mga lumang bakal na tubo, bote ng salamin, plastic containers, at papel na dyaryo po kami. May aluminum trays din mula sa canteen cleanup.
A small shop has old magazines, paper bags, cardboard cartons, plastic packaging, and glass jars. We also found a damaged phone charger and an old metal shelf bracket.
May karton, aluminum cans, glass bottles, at plastic containers po mula sa event. May mga lumang copper wires at sirang keyboard din sa storage room.
